info.name: Petyard assistant cart - default-off API
info.description: Local requests only; nothing has been published. API remains default-off pending reviewed setup, native proof and approved policy. Requires a real owned retained catalog card in the test account. All variables are local placeholders, no credentials. Only authenticated users; guest migration is excluded. Read AI_ASSISTANT_CART_CONTRACT.md before running.
